name: Mike Patrick
role: U.S. Army — believed a ranger with a MACV special operations group
summary: The tall American at the center of the strike-force group photo on Núi Bà Đen (VN-0010), arm around one of the trainees. Larry thinks he was a ranger with a special operations group for MACV, and says he was what you would call a ghost or a spook — though Larry doesn't know why he was called that.
larrysRecollection: Mike Patrick is the guy in the center. My father thinks he was a ranger, special operations group for MACV. He was what you would call a ghost or a spook, my father says he doesn't know why they called him this or referred to him of this. (VN-0010 Memories comment, relayed 2026-08-15)
researchNotes: One of the few people in the archive with both a first and last name — genuinely searchable. 'Special operations group for MACV' reads naturally as MACV-SOG (activated January 1964), which would fit the 'ghost'/'spook' reputation and the duck-hunter-camouflaged irregulars around him; treat as a lead against SOG rosters and association membership lists, not a settled assignment. He is a strong candidate to have known the Núi Bà Đen camp personnel (Lowry, unresolved #4).
